question: What is the total revenue per customer for customers in India?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('completed','shipped') AND c.country = 'India' GROUP BY c.id, c.name

question: Which customers have placed more than 5 orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

question: List customers who bought products from more than 2 different categories
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) AS category_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) > 2

question: What percentage of all orders are cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') / COUNT(*) AS cancelled_pct FROM orders

question: Which category has the highest total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT cat.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM categories cat JOIN products p ON p.category_id = cat.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('completed','shipped') GROUP BY cat.id, cat.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: For each customer country, what is the total revenue?

question: What is the average number of line items per order?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_line_items FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t

question: Show customers whose total revenue is above the average total revenue per customer
gold_sql: WITH rev AS (SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('completed','shipped') GROUP BY c.id, c.name) SELECT name, total_revenue FROM rev WHERE total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM rev)

question: List products that have never been ordered
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id = p.id)

question: What share of total revenue does each product category contribute, as a percentage?
gold_sql: SELECT cat.name, 100.0 * SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / SUM(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)) OVER () AS revenue_pct FROM categories cat JOIN products p ON p.category_id = cat.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('completed','shipped') GROUP BY cat.id, cat.name

question: Show the top 3 products by revenue within each category
gold_sql: SELECT category, product, total_revenue FROM (SELECT cat.name AS category, p.name AS product, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cat.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC) AS rn FROM categories cat JOIN products p ON p.category_id = cat.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('completed','shipped') GROUP BY cat.id, cat.name, p.id, p.name) t WHERE rn <= 3
